title: X 光光電子能譜儀~X-ray photoelectron spectrometers
focus: 光電子結合能、非彈性平均自由徑、單色器與半球分析器的表面化學分析工程~Photoelectron binding energy, inelastic mean free path, monochromator and hemispherical analyser engineering for surface chemistry
summary: 從光電效應的能量守恆與電子的非彈性平均自由徑出發，理解 XPS 為何只看最表面 10 nm 並能分辨化學態，再把 Al Kα 單色器、半球型能量分析器、能量尺度校正、定量與偵測極限、超高真空與深度剖析整合成可驗收的表面分析儀器工程。~Start from photoelectric energy conservation and the electron inelastic mean free path to see why XPS probes only the top 10 nm yet resolves chemical states, then integrate the Al Kα monochromator, hemispherical energy analyser, energy-scale calibration, quantification and detection limits, ultrahigh vacuum and depth profiling into an acceptable surface-analysis instrument record.

units.anchor: 光電子動能與結合能~Photoelectron kinetic and binding energy
units.title: 光電效應、結合能與化學位移~Photoelectric effect, binding energy and chemical shift
units.mechanism: 單色 X 光打在樣品上，把內層電子激發出來；量到的光電子動能 E_k 與結合能 E_b 由能量守恆連結：E_b = hν − E_k − φ，其中 φ 是分析器的功函數，因為樣品與分析器電性連接時以共同的費米能階為能量零點。每個元素的內層能階是指紋，而同一元素在不同化學環境下結合能會移動零點幾到數 eV，氧化態越高位移越正，這就是 XPS 能分辨 Si 與 SiO₂、C–C 與 C=O 的根據。~Monochromatic X-rays eject core electrons from the sample; the measured kinetic energy E_k and the binding energy E_b are linked by energy conservation, E_b = hν − E_k − φ, where φ is the analyser work function because a sample in electrical contact with the analyser shares its Fermi level as the energy zero. Each element's core levels are a fingerprint, and the same element shifts by a few tenths to several electronvolts in different chemical environments, more positive for higher oxidation states, which is how XPS separates Si from SiO₂ or C–C from C=O.
units.model: Al Kα 光子能量 hν = 1486.6 eV，分析器功函數取 φ = 4.5 eV。元素 Si 2p 的 E_b = 99.4 eV，光電子動能 E_k = 1486.6 − 99.4 − 4.5 = 1382.7 eV；SiO₂ 中 Si 2p 位移到 103.4 eV，動能降為 1378.7 eV，差 4.0 eV。C 1s 參考峰 284.8 eV 對應 E_k = 1197.3 eV；若改用 Mg Kα（1253.6 eV），同一 Si 2p 的動能變為 1149.7 eV，但結合能不變，這是辨認歐傑峰（動能固定）與光電子峰（結合能固定）的方法。~With Al Kα photons hν = 1486.6 eV and an analyser work function φ = 4.5 eV, elemental Si 2p at E_b = 99.4 eV gives photoelectrons of E_k = 1486.6 − 99.4 − 4.5 = 1382.7 eV; in SiO₂ the Si 2p shifts to 103.4 eV and the kinetic energy drops to 1378.7 eV, a 4.0 eV difference. The C 1s reference at 284.8 eV corresponds to E_k = 1197.3 eV; switching to Mg Kα (1253.6 eV) moves the same Si 2p to 1149.7 eV while its binding energy is unchanged, which is how Auger peaks (fixed kinetic energy) are told from photoelectron peaks (fixed binding energy).
units.verify: 在濺射清潔的 Si 晶圓上取 Si 2p 高解析譜，確認元素峰在 99.4 eV 附近、2p₃/₂ 與 2p₁/₂ 自旋軌道分裂 0.6 eV；再量帶自然氧化層的晶圓，確認 103 到 104 eV 的氧化峰；最後用兩種陽極或與 NIST XPS 資料庫比對，確認歐傑峰隨光子能量移動而光電子峰不動。~Take a high-resolution Si 2p spectrum on a sputter-cleaned Si wafer, confirming the elemental peak near 99.4 eV with a 0.6 eV spin-orbit splitting between 2p₃/₂ and 2p₁/₂; then measure a wafer with native oxide and confirm the oxide component at 103 to 104 eV; finally use two anodes or the NIST XPS database to check that Auger peaks move with photon energy while photoelectron peaks do not.
units.failure: 把譜圖中的歐傑峰（如 O KLL 在 Al Kα 下落在約 978 eV 結合能處）誤認為某元素的光電子峰，會報告根本不存在的元素；或者把樣品接觸不良造成的整體位移解釋成化學態變化。~Mistaking an Auger peak, such as O KLL appearing near 978 eV on the binding-energy scale under Al Kα, for a photoelectron peak reports an element that is not there; likewise a rigid shift caused by poor sample contact can be misread as a chemical-state change.
units.misconception: 結合能是元素的固定常數，不會因為化學環境而改變。~Binding energy is a fixed constant of an element and never changes with chemical environment.

units.anchor: 非彈性平均自由徑 λ~Inelastic mean free path λ
units.title: 表面靈敏度與資訊深度~Surface sensitivity and information depth
units.mechanism: X 光可穿入樣品數微米，但只有沒有損失能量就逃出表面的光電子才形成特徵峰；電子在固體中發生非彈性散射前平均走的距離稱為非彈性平均自由徑 λ，在 1 keV 附近多數材料為 1 到 4 nm。來自深度 z 的訊號以 exp(−z/(λ·cosθ)) 衰減，θ 是出射角相對表面法線，95% 的訊號來自 3λ·cosθ 以內。因此 XPS 的資訊深度約 10 nm，傾斜樣品可以把它縮到幾 nm，這是角解析 XPS 量超薄膜厚度的基礎。~X-rays penetrate micrometres into a sample, but only photoelectrons that escape without losing energy form the characteristic peaks; the mean distance an electron travels before an inelastic event is the inelastic mean free path λ, between 1 and 4 nm for most materials near 1 keV. Signal from depth z is attenuated as exp(−z/(λ·cosθ)), with θ the emission angle from the surface normal, and 95% of the signal comes from within 3λ·cosθ. The information depth is therefore about 10 nm, and tilting the sample shrinks it to a few nanometres, the basis of angle-resolved XPS thickness measurement of ultrathin films.
units.model: 取 Si 2p 在 SiO₂ 中的 λ_ox = 3.4 nm（TPP-2M 估計，Al Kα）。資訊深度 3λ·cosθ：θ = 0° 時 10.2 nm，θ = 60° 時 5.1 nm。氧化層厚度由強度比求得：d = λ_ox·cosθ·ln(1 + (I_ox/I_Si)/R₀)，R₀ ≈ 0.9 為厚氧化層與純 Si 的強度比。量得 I_ox/I_Si = 0.5、θ = 0°：d = 3.4×ln(1 + 0.556) = 3.4×0.442 ≈ 1.5 nm；同一樣品轉到 θ = 45° 時模型預測比值升到 0.9×(exp(1.5/2.40) − 1) ≈ 0.78。~Take λ_ox = 3.4 nm for Si 2p in SiO₂ (TPP-2M estimate, Al Kα). The information depth 3λ·cosθ is 10.2 nm at θ = 0° and 5.1 nm at θ = 60°. Oxide thickness follows from the intensity ratio d = λ_ox·cosθ·ln(1 + (I_ox/I_Si)/R₀), with R₀ ≈ 0.9 the ratio for thick oxide against clean Si. For a measured I_ox/I_Si = 0.5 at θ = 0°: d = 3.4×ln(1 + 0.556) = 3.4×0.442 ≈ 1.5 nm; tilting the same sample to θ = 45° should raise the ratio to 0.9×(exp(1.5/2.40) − 1) ≈ 0.78.
units.verify: 在 0°、45°、60° 三個出射角量同一片自然氧化矽的 Si 2p 比值，以上式分別算厚度，三者應一致在 ±0.2 nm 內；再用橢偏儀或 TEM 截面量同一片，比較絕對值。λ 值以 NIST SRD 71 資料庫或 TPP-2M 公式取得並記錄所用參數。~Measure the Si 2p ratio of one native-oxide wafer at emission angles of 0°, 45° and 60°, compute the thickness from each with the formula and require agreement within ±0.2 nm; then compare the absolute value with ellipsometry or a TEM cross-section of the same wafer. Obtain λ from the NIST SRD 71 database or the TPP-2M formula and record the parameters used.
units.failure: 表面 1 nm 的碳污染會把下層訊號衰減約 25%，若不校正，定量把污染當成樣品成分，膜厚被高估；粗糙表面讓有效出射角分佈變寬，角解析厚度在高角度處系統性偏離。~A 1 nm carbon contamination layer attenuates the underlying signal by about 25%; uncorrected, quantification counts the contamination as sample and film thickness is overestimated, while a rough surface broadens the effective emission-angle distribution so angle-resolved thickness drifts systematically at high angles.
units.misconception: X 光能穿透幾微米，所以 XPS 的分析深度也是幾微米。~X-rays penetrate micrometres, so the XPS analysis depth is also micrometres.

units.anchor: Al 陽極與石英單色器~Al anode and quartz monochromator
units.title: X 光源與單色器設計~X-ray source and monochromator design
units.mechanism: 電子束轟擊鋁陽極產生 Al Kα 特徵線，但原始譜線寬約 0.85 eV，還伴隨 Kα₃,₄ 衛星峰與連續的制動輻射。單色器用彎曲的石英單晶以布拉格繞射只挑出 Kα₁,₂ 核心，線寬縮到約 0.25 eV，並去除衛星與背景；陽極、晶體與樣品位於同一個 Rowland 圓上，晶體經彎曲與研磨使聚焦同時滿足布拉格條件。微聚焦的電子束讓 X 光斑小到 10 µm 等級，可做小區域分析與影像。~Electron bombardment of an aluminium anode produces the Al Kα line, but the raw line is about 0.85 eV wide and comes with Kα₃,₄ satellites and a bremsstrahlung continuum. A monochromator uses a bent quartz single crystal in Bragg diffraction to select only the Kα₁,₂ core, narrowing the width to about 0.25 eV and removing satellites and background; anode, crystal and sample lie on one Rowland circle, and the crystal is bent and ground so that focusing and the Bragg condition hold together. A microfocused electron beam makes X-ray spots down to the 10 µm scale for small-area analysis and imaging.
units.model: Al Kα 波長 λ = 0.834 nm，石英 (10-10) 面間距 d = 0.4255 nm：布拉格 sinθ = λ/(2d) = 0.834/0.851 = 0.980，θ ≈ 78.5°，接近背向繞射使能量色散最強。能量解析 ΔE/E = cotθ·Δθ，cot 78.5° = 0.203；若光斑與晶體幾何給 Δθ = 1 mrad，ΔE = 1486.6×0.203×0.001 ≈ 0.30 eV，與 0.25 eV 等級的單色線寬一致；Δθ 放寬到 3 mrad 時線寬變為 0.9 eV，單色化的好處消失。~For Al Kα, λ = 0.834 nm and the quartz (10-10) spacing is d = 0.4255 nm: Bragg sinθ = λ/(2d) = 0.834/0.851 = 0.980, so θ ≈ 78.5°, near back-reflection where energy dispersion is strongest. Energy resolution follows ΔE/E = cotθ·Δθ with cot 78.5° = 0.203; if spot and crystal geometry give Δθ = 1 mrad, ΔE = 1486.6×0.203×0.001 ≈ 0.30 eV, consistent with a monochromated linewidth near 0.25 eV, whereas Δθ of 3 mrad makes 0.9 eV and the benefit of monochromation disappears.
units.verify: 以清潔銀片的 Ag 3d₅/₂ 峰在低通能下量 FWHM，單色器對準正確時應在 0.45 到 0.55 eV；檢查譜圖在主峰高結合能側 9.8 eV 處是否還有 Kα₃,₄ 衛星殘留；用 Faraday 杯或螢光屏確認 X 光斑位置與分析器視野重合，並記錄陽極功率對計數率的線性。~Measure the Ag 3d₅/₂ FWHM on clean silver at low pass energy, which with a correctly aligned monochromator should be 0.45 to 0.55 eV; check for residual Kα₃,₄ satellites 9.8 eV above the main peak on the binding-energy scale; confirm with a Faraday cup or phosphor screen that the X-ray spot coincides with the analyser field of view, and record count rate versus anode power for linearity.
units.failure: 陽極鋁膜被電子束局部燒穿露出銅底材，譜圖出現 Cu Lα 激發的鬼峰；單色晶體或陽極位置偏離 Rowland 圓時，光斑變大、強度掉一半以上，而操作者常誤以為是樣品訊號弱。~An anode whose aluminium film is burned through locally exposes the copper base and ghost peaks excited by Cu Lα appear; when the crystal or anode drifts off the Rowland circle the spot grows and intensity falls by more than half, which operators often misattribute to a weak sample.
units.misconception: 單色器只是減少背景，對能量解析度沒有幫助。~A monochromator only reduces background and does nothing for energy resolution.

units.anchor: 半球型分析器與通能~Hemispherical analyser and pass energy
units.title: 半球型能量分析器與偵測器~Hemispherical energy analyser and detector
units.mechanism: 光電子先由靜電透鏡收集並減速到固定的通能 E_p，再進入兩個同心半球之間的徑向電場；只有能量等於 E_p 的電子沿中央軌道到達出口，能量偏高或偏低者打到內外球。分析器的絕對解析度與通能成正比，與狹縫寬度、球半徑和入射角展寬有關，所以高解析譜用 10 到 20 eV 的通能，巡掃用 100 到 160 eV 以換取計數率。出口處以多通道電子倍增器或延遲線偵測器平行記錄一段能量範圍，提高效率並支援能量分散的快照模式。~Photoelectrons are collected by an electrostatic lens and retarded to a fixed pass energy E_p before entering the radial field between two concentric hemispheres; only electrons at E_p follow the central orbit to the exit, while faster or slower ones strike the outer or inner sphere. The absolute resolution scales with pass energy and depends on slit width, sphere radius and angular spread, so high-resolution spectra use 10 to 20 eV pass energy and survey scans use 100 to 160 eV to buy count rate. At the exit a multichannel electron multiplier or delay-line detector records an energy window in parallel, raising efficiency and enabling energy-dispersive snapshot modes.
units.model: 半球分析器解析度 ΔE ≈ E_p·(w/(2R₀) + α²/4)。取平均半徑 R₀ = 165 mm、狹縫 w = 1 mm、半接受角 α = 3°（0.052 rad）：w/(2R₀) = 3.0×10⁻³，α²/4 = 6.8×10⁻⁴，合計 3.7×10⁻³；E_p = 20 eV 時 ΔE ≈ 0.074 eV，E_p = 160 eV 時 ≈ 0.59 eV。與 0.25 eV 的 X 光線寬及 Ag 3d₅/₂ 約 0.30 eV 的本徵寬度合成：√(0.25² + 0.074² + 0.30²) ≈ 0.40 eV，解釋了低通能下實測約 0.45 eV 的峰寬；計數率約與 E_p 成正比，20 eV 比 160 eV 少約 8 倍。~The hemispherical resolution is ΔE ≈ E_p·(w/(2R₀) + α²/4). With mean radius R₀ = 165 mm, slit w = 1 mm and half acceptance angle α = 3° (0.052 rad): w/(2R₀) = 3.0×10⁻³, α²/4 = 6.8×10⁻⁴, total 3.7×10⁻³; at E_p = 20 eV, ΔE ≈ 0.074 eV, and at 160 eV about 0.59 eV. Combined with the 0.25 eV X-ray width and the roughly 0.30 eV intrinsic width of Ag 3d₅/₂: √(0.25² + 0.074² + 0.30²) ≈ 0.40 eV, explaining the measured width near 0.45 eV at low pass energy; count rate scales roughly with E_p, about 8 times lower at 20 eV than at 160 eV.
units.verify: 在 5、10、20、40、80、160 eV 通能各量一次 Ag 3d₅/₂，把 FWHM 對 E_p 作圖，截距給出 X 光與本徵寬度的合成，斜率給出分析器項，與上式比較；同時記錄各通能的峰計數率，確認近似線性，並檢查偵測器在高計數率下的死時間修正。~Measure Ag 3d₅/₂ at pass energies of 5, 10, 20, 40, 80 and 160 eV, plot FWHM against E_p, and compare the intercept (X-ray plus intrinsic width) and slope (analyser term) with the formula; log the peak count rate at each pass energy to confirm near-linearity, and check the detector's dead-time correction at high rates.
units.failure: 半球內表面沉積污染或透鏡電壓漂移會讓中央軌道偏移，所有峰往同一方向移動 0.1 到 0.3 eV 且峰形不對稱；若只用固定的校正偏移修正，化學態判讀仍會錯，而偵測器某些通道老化會在快照譜上留下固定位置的凹陷。~Contamination on the hemisphere surfaces or drifting lens voltages shifts the central orbit, moving every peak 0.1 to 0.3 eV the same way with asymmetric shapes; a fixed calibration offset cannot repair chemical-state assignments, and aged detector channels leave dips at fixed positions in snapshot spectra.
units.misconception: 通能越高解析度越好，因為電子能量越高越容易分開。~Higher pass energy gives better resolution because faster electrons are easier to separate.

units.anchor: Au/Ag/Cu 能量尺度基準~Au/Ag/Cu energy-scale references
units.title: 能量尺度校正與電荷補償~Energy-scale calibration and charge compensation
units.mechanism: 能量尺度以 ISO 15472 規定的三個金屬參考峰校正：Au 4f₇/₂ = 83.96 eV、Ag 3d₅/₂ = 368.21 eV、Cu 2p₃/₂ = 932.62 eV，涵蓋 85 到 933 eV 的範圍，可同時決定零點偏移與線性誤差。絕緣樣品在 X 光下持續失去電子而帶正電，峰向高結合能移動數 eV 並變寬，需要低能電子與離子的電荷中和槍補償；殘餘位移通常以外來碳 C 1s = 284.8 eV 做參考，但這個方法本身有 ±0.3 eV 的不確定度。~The energy scale is calibrated with the three metal reference peaks prescribed by ISO 15472, Au 4f₇/₂ = 83.96 eV, Ag 3d₅/₂ = 368.21 eV and Cu 2p₃/₂ = 932.62 eV, which span 85 to 933 eV and determine both the zero offset and the linearity error. Insulating samples lose electrons under X-rays and charge positively, shifting peaks several electronvolts to higher binding energy and broadening them, so a charge-neutraliser supplying low-energy electrons and ions is required; residual shift is usually referenced to adventitious carbon C 1s = 284.8 eV, a method that itself carries about ±0.3 eV uncertainty.
units.model: 量得 Au 4f₇/₂ = 84.10 eV、Cu 2p₃/₂ = 932.90 eV：零點偏移 +0.14 eV，線性誤差 (0.28 − 0.14)/(932.62 − 83.96) = 1.65×10⁻⁴（165 ppm）。修正式 E_true = E_meas − 0.14 − 1.65×10⁻⁴×(E_meas − 84.10)；對 O 1s 在 532.0 eV 的峰，修正量為 0.14 + 0.074 = 0.21 eV。ISO 15472 的允收要求是三個參考峰的殘差都在 ±0.1 eV 內，此例需調整分析器的能量尺度係數後重量。~Measured Au 4f₇/₂ = 84.10 eV and Cu 2p₃/₂ = 932.90 eV give a zero offset of +0.14 eV and a linearity error of (0.28 − 0.14)/(932.62 − 83.96) = 1.65×10⁻⁴ (165 ppm). The correction is E_true = E_meas − 0.14 − 1.65×10⁻⁴×(E_meas − 84.10); for an O 1s peak at 532.0 eV the correction is 0.14 + 0.074 = 0.21 eV. ISO 15472 acceptance asks for residuals within ±0.1 eV at all three references, so this case needs the analyser's energy-scale coefficient adjusted and re-measured.
units.verify: 每月在濺射清潔的 Au、Ag、Cu 箔上量三個參考峰（低通能、同一透鏡模式），記錄偏移與線性，超出 ±0.1 eV 即重新校正；電荷補償用 PET 或 PTFE 等絕緣標準片，檢查 C 1s 的 CF₂ 峰在 292 eV 附近且 FWHM 不因充電而變寬，並比較中和槍開關前後的峰位與峰寬。~Each month measure the three reference peaks on sputter-cleaned Au, Ag and Cu foils at low pass energy in one lens mode, log offset and linearity, and recalibrate whenever residuals exceed ±0.1 eV; test charge compensation with insulating standards such as PET or PTFE, checking that the CF₂ component of C 1s sits near 292 eV with no charging broadening, and compare peak positions and widths with the neutraliser on and off.
units.failure: 導電樣品以 C 1s = 284.8 eV 強行參考，會把本來正確的能量尺度平移 0.2 到 0.5 eV，化學態判讀全錯；絕緣樣品中和不足時，同一元素的峰因局部充電不均分裂成兩個，被誤判為兩種化學態。~Forcing C 1s = 284.8 eV referencing on a conducting sample shifts an already correct scale by 0.2 to 0.5 eV and corrupts every chemical-state assignment; an under-neutralised insulator shows peaks split in two by non-uniform local charging, which are mistaken for two chemical states.
units.misconception: 只要用 C 1s = 284.8 eV 校正，任何樣品的結合能都能準到 0.1 eV。~Referencing C 1s to 284.8 eV makes binding energies accurate to 0.1 eV on any sample.

units.anchor: 相對靈敏度因子與背景扣除~Relative sensitivity factors and background subtraction
units.title: 定量分析、偵測極限與雜訊~Quantification, detection limits and noise
units.mechanism: 峰面積 I_i 正比於元素濃度 n_i、光游離截面 σ_i、非彈性平均自由徑 λ_i 與分析器傳輸函數 T(E_k)；把這些合併成相對靈敏度因子 S_i 後，原子百分比為 (I_i/S_i)/Σ(I_j/S_j)。面積必須先扣除 Shirley 或 Tougaard 背景，因為非彈性散射電子形成的階梯背景比峰本身還大。偵測極限由背景的 Poisson 統計決定，典型為 0.1 到 1 原子百分比，與元素截面、譜線重疊及取樣時間有關；均勻性假設不成立時，定量只代表資訊深度內的加權平均。~A peak area I_i is proportional to the element's concentration n_i, photoionisation cross-section σ_i, inelastic mean free path λ_i and the analyser transmission T(E_k); folding these into a relative sensitivity factor S_i gives the atomic fraction (I_i/S_i)/Σ(I_j/S_j). Areas must first be freed of a Shirley or Tougaard background, because the step-like background of inelastically scattered electrons is larger than the peak itself. The detection limit is set by Poisson statistics of the background, typically 0.1 to 1 atomic percent depending on cross-section, line overlap and acquisition time; when the homogeneity assumption fails, the result is only a weighted average over the information depth.
units.model: Scofield 截面（相對 C 1s = 1）：O 1s 2.93、Si 2p 0.82。某氧化矽樣品扣背景後 O 1s 面積 12 000、Si 2p 面積 2 000：I/σ 分別為 4 096 與 2 439，O 佔 62.7 at%、Si 37.3 at%，O/Si = 1.68；再用 λ ∝ E_k^0.75 修正動能差（O 1s 953 eV、Si 2p 1383 eV，比值 0.757），O 項變為 5 411，O/Si 升到 2.22，接近 SiO₂ 的 2。偵測極限：背景每通道 10⁴ 計數時 3√B = 300 計數；主元素峰 3×10⁵ 計數代表 100 at%，則 300 計數約為 0.1 at%。~Scofield cross-sections relative to C 1s = 1: O 1s 2.93, Si 2p 0.82. For a silicon-oxide sample with background-subtracted areas of 12 000 (O 1s) and 2 000 (Si 2p), I/σ is 4 096 and 2 439, giving 62.7 at% O and 37.3 at% Si, O/Si = 1.68; correcting the kinetic-energy difference with λ ∝ E_k^0.75 (O 1s at 953 eV, Si 2p at 1383 eV, ratio 0.757) raises the O term to 5 411 and O/Si to 2.22, close to 2 for SiO₂. Detection limit: with 10⁴ background counts per channel, 3√B = 300 counts; if the major peak holds 3×10⁵ counts for 100 at%, 300 counts is about 0.1 at%.
units.verify: 用已知化學計量的標準（如熱氧化 SiO₂、PET 的 C/O = 10/4）定量，結果應在 ±10% 相對誤差內；比較 Shirley 與 Tougaard 背景對面積的影響並記錄；對微量元素延長取樣時間，確認偵測極限按 1/√t 改善，並用 Ag 3d 計數率監控儀器靈敏度的長期漂移。~Quantify standards of known stoichiometry, such as thermal SiO₂ or PET with C/O = 10/4, expecting agreement within ±10% relative; compare the effect of Shirley versus Tougaard backgrounds on areas and record it; for trace elements extend acquisition and confirm that the detection limit improves as 1/√t, and monitor long-term sensitivity drift with the Ag 3d count rate.
units.failure: 忽略傳輸函數隨動能的變化，用另一台儀器的靈敏度因子做定量，高動能元素被系統性低估 20% 以上；對含碳污染層的樣品直接定量，則所有基材元素被稀釋，報告出的化學計量與真實材料不符。~Ignoring the kinetic-energy dependence of the transmission function and quantifying with another instrument's sensitivity factors underestimates high-kinetic-energy elements by more than 20%; quantifying a carbon-contaminated sample as measured dilutes every substrate element so the reported stoichiometry does not match the real material.
units.misconception: 譜圖上的峰高比就直接等於原子比。~The ratio of peak heights in the spectrum directly equals the atomic ratio.

units.anchor: UHV 分析腔與離子槍~UHV analysis chamber and ion gun
units.title: 超高真空、污染控制與深度剖析~Ultrahigh vacuum, contamination control and depth profiling
units.mechanism: XPS 只看最表面幾奈米，所以分析腔必須在 10⁻⁹ mbar 以下，否則殘氣在一次長時間取樣內就會在表面累積碳與氧；樣品經傳送腔進入，表面清潔用低能 Ar⁺ 濺射。深度剖析交替進行濺射與取譜，用單原子 Ar⁺ 可剖析無機層，氣體團簇離子（Ar₁₀₀₀⁺ 等）可剖析有機層而不破壞化學態；濺射速率由束流密度、濺射產率與材料原子密度決定。整合時要安排 X 光斑、分析器視野與離子濺射坑的同心與尺寸關係，否則剖析深度解析度被坑壁效應破壞。~Because XPS sees only the top few nanometres, the analysis chamber must stay below 10⁻⁹ mbar or residual gas deposits carbon and oxygen within one long acquisition; samples enter through a load lock and surfaces are cleaned by low-energy Ar⁺ sputtering. Depth profiling alternates sputtering and spectra, using monatomic Ar⁺ for inorganic layers and gas-cluster ions such as Ar₁₀₀₀⁺ for organic layers without destroying chemical states; the sputter rate is set by current density, sputter yield and the material's atomic density. Integration must keep the X-ray spot, analyser field of view and sputter crater concentric and correctly sized, or crater-wall effects ruin the depth resolution.
units.model: 單分子層時間：在 10⁻⁹ mbar、黏附係數 1 時約 1 000 s，黏附係數 0.1 時約 2.8 h，所以 30 分鐘的高解析譜在 10⁻⁹ mbar 下可累積約 0.1 單層碳。濺射速率：Ar⁺ 1 keV、束流 1 µA 掃描 2 mm×2 mm 面積，電流密度 25 µA/cm² 即 1.56×10¹⁴ ions/(cm²·s)；SiO₂ 的濺射產率取 1 atom/ion、原子密度 6.6×10²² cm⁻³，速率 ≈ 1.56×10¹⁴/6.6×10²² = 2.4×10⁻⁹ cm/s ≈ 1.4 nm/min；100 nm 的氧化層需約 70 分鐘。~Monolayer time: about 1 000 s at 10⁻⁹ mbar with sticking coefficient 1, about 2.8 h with 0.1, so a 30-minute high-resolution spectrum at 10⁻⁹ mbar accumulates roughly 0.1 monolayer of carbon. Sputter rate: 1 keV Ar⁺ at 1 µA rastered over 2 mm×2 mm is 25 µA/cm² or 1.56×10¹⁴ ions/(cm²·s); with a SiO₂ sputter yield of 1 atom/ion and atomic density 6.6×10²² cm⁻³ the rate is ≈ 1.56×10¹⁴/6.6×10²² = 2.4×10⁻⁹ cm/s ≈ 1.4 nm/min, so a 100 nm oxide takes about 70 minutes.
units.verify: 以殘氣分析儀記錄分析腔的 H₂O、CO 與碳氫分壓；用已知厚度的 Ta₂O₅/Ta 參考層（30 nm 或 100 nm）做深度剖析，從達到界面的時間反推濺射速率，並以 84% 到 16% 強度落差對應的深度定義深度解析度；用輪廓儀量濺射坑深度與平整度，確認坑底平坦區大於分析面積。~Log H₂O, CO and hydrocarbon partial pressures in the analysis chamber with a residual-gas analyser; profile a Ta₂O₅/Ta reference layer of known thickness (30 nm or 100 nm), derive the sputter rate from the time to reach the interface and define the depth resolution as the depth between the 84% and 16% intensity levels; measure crater depth and flatness with a profilometer, confirming that the flat crater floor exceeds the analysed area.
units.failure: 濺射坑與分析區沒有同心，坑壁未被完全剖析的材料持續貢獻訊號，深度剖析中薄層的界面被拖長、彷彿層間互擴散；單原子 Ar⁺ 剖析聚合物時化學鍵被打斷，C 1s 的 C=O 成分消失，被誤判為材料本身沒有這種鍵結。~A sputter crater not concentric with the analysed area leaves crater walls contributing un-profiled material, so interfaces smear as if the layers had interdiffused; monatomic Ar⁺ profiling of a polymer breaks bonds and the C=O component of C 1s vanishes, misread as absence of that bond in the material.
units.misconception: 真空只要能讓 X 光源正常運作就夠了，對譜圖品質沒有影響。~Vacuum only needs to keep the X-ray source running and does not affect spectrum quality.

units.anchor: 儀器驗收表與標準樣品組~Instrument acceptance table and reference-sample set
units.title: 儀器驗收、長期監控與工程交接~Instrument acceptance, long-term monitoring and engineering handoff
units.mechanism: XPS 的驗收把能量尺度、解析度、靈敏度、電荷補償、空間解析與深度剖析能力各自定義成可量化的測試：ISO 15472 三點校正、Ag 3d₅/₂ 在指定通能的峰寬與計數率、絕緣標準片的峰位與峰寬、刀口或網格的 X 光斑尺寸、Ta₂O₅ 參考層的深度解析度。交接時要留下校正時間表、每項測試的接受值與實測值、所用標準片的來源與清潔程序，以及靈敏度與能量尺度的長期趨勢圖，讓後續操作者能判斷儀器是否仍在受控狀態。~XPS acceptance defines energy scale, resolution, sensitivity, charge compensation, spatial resolution and depth-profiling capability as separate quantified tests: the three-point ISO 15472 calibration, Ag 3d₅/₂ width and count rate at a specified pass energy, peak position and width on insulating standards, X-ray spot size from a knife edge or grid, and depth resolution on a Ta₂O₅ reference layer. The handoff leaves a calibration schedule, acceptance and measured values for every test, the provenance and cleaning procedure of each standard, and trend charts of sensitivity and energy scale, so later operators can judge whether the instrument remains in control.
units.model: 驗收門檻範例：Au、Ag、Cu 三點殘差 ≤ ±0.1 eV；Ag 3d₅/₂ 在 E_p = 20 eV 的 FWHM ≤ 0.50 eV，計數率 ≥ 1×10⁶ cps（400 µm 光斑）；PET 標準片 C 1s 的 C–C 與 O–C=O 分離 4.0 ± 0.2 eV；Ta₂O₅ 30 nm 參考層的深度解析度 ≤ 3 nm（即 10%）；光斑尺寸由刀口掃描的 16% 到 84% 寬度定義，400 µm 模式實測 ≤ 450 µm。若靈敏度趨勢在 6 個月內下降超過 30%，排程更換陽極或檢查偵測器。~Example acceptance thresholds: residuals at Au, Ag and Cu within ±0.1 eV; Ag 3d₅/₂ FWHM ≤ 0.50 eV at E_p = 20 eV with a count rate ≥ 1×10⁶ cps for a 400 µm spot; on a PET standard the C 1s separation between C–C and O–C=O at 4.0 ± 0.2 eV; depth resolution ≤ 3 nm (10%) on a 30 nm Ta₂O₅ reference; spot size defined by the 16% to 84% width of a knife-edge scan, measured ≤ 450 µm in 400 µm mode. A sensitivity trend falling more than 30% within 6 months schedules anode replacement or detector inspection.
units.verify: 依序執行三點校正、Ag 3d 解析度與計數率、PET 電荷補償、刀口光斑、Ta₂O₅ 深度剖析五項測試，各重複三次取平均與標準差；把結果與上次驗收及廠商規格並列，任何項目超出門檻先排除樣品與清潔因素，再追查單色器、透鏡與偵測器，修復後整組重測。~Run the five tests in order, three-point calibration, Ag 3d resolution and count rate, PET charge compensation, knife-edge spot size and Ta₂O₅ depth profile, each three times with mean and standard deviation; set the results beside the previous acceptance and the vendor specification, and for any item outside threshold first exclude sample and cleaning causes, then trace the monochromator, lens and detector, repeating the whole set after repair.
units.failure: 只在安裝時驗收而無長期趨勢，陽極老化讓計數率一年內掉到三分之一，微量元素偵測極限悄悄從 0.1 at% 退到 0.3 at%，使用者卻以為樣品真的更乾淨；交接紀錄缺少標準片清潔程序，新操作者用氧化的銀片校正，解析度與靈敏度兩項全部誤判。~Accepting only at installation without trend data lets anode ageing cut the count rate to a third within a year, quietly degrading the trace detection limit from 0.1 at% to 0.3 at% while users believe their samples are cleaner; a handoff lacking the standard-cleaning procedure makes a new operator calibrate on oxidised silver and misjudge both resolution and sensitivity.
units.misconception: 安裝時通過驗收的儀器，之後的數據自動可信。~An instrument that passed acceptance at installation produces trustworthy data from then on.

example: 氧化層厚度與定量練習：在 θ = 0° 量得矽晶圓的 Si 2p 氧化峰與元素峰面積比 I_ox/I_Si = 0.50，取 λ_ox = 3.4 nm、R₀ = 0.9，厚度 d = 3.4×ln(1 + 0.50/0.9) = 3.4×0.442 ≈ 1.5 nm。把樣品轉到 θ = 45°（cosθ = 0.707），模型預測比值為 0.9×(exp(1.5/(3.4×0.707)) − 1) = 0.9×(exp(0.624) − 1) ≈ 0.78；若實測為 0.76，兩角度反推的厚度分別為 1.50 nm 與 1.47 nm，一致性在 ±0.1 nm 內，支持均勻薄膜假設。再以 Scofield 截面定量同一表面：O 1s 面積 12 000 ÷ 2.93 = 4 096，Si 2p 面積 2 000 ÷ 0.82 = 2 439，經 λ ∝ E_k^0.75 修正後 O/Si ≈ 2.2，與 1.5 nm 的 SiO₂ 加上部分基材 Si 的訊號相符。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實機規格。~Oxide-thickness and quantification exercise: at θ = 0° the Si 2p oxide-to-element area ratio on a silicon wafer is I_ox/I_Si = 0.50; with λ_ox = 3.4 nm and R₀ = 0.9 the thickness is d = 3.4×ln(1 + 0.50/0.9) = 3.4×0.442 ≈ 1.5 nm. Tilting to θ = 45° (cosθ = 0.707) the model predicts a ratio of 0.9×(exp(1.5/(3.4×0.707)) − 1) = 0.9×(exp(0.624) − 1) ≈ 0.78; if 0.76 is measured, the two angles return 1.50 nm and 1.47 nm, consistent within ±0.1 nm and supporting the uniform-film assumption. Quantifying the same surface with Scofield cross-sections: O 1s area 12 000 ÷ 2.93 = 4 096 and Si 2p area 2 000 ÷ 0.82 = 2 439, and after the λ ∝ E_k^0.75 correction O/Si ≈ 2.2, consistent with 1.5 nm of SiO₂ plus some substrate Si signal. Values are teaching assumptions, not any instrument's specification.
history: 1950 到 1960 年代 Kai Siegbahn 在烏普薩拉大學建立高解析電子能譜儀並證明內層結合能的化學位移，把技術命名為 ESCA，1981 年獲諾貝爾物理獎；1969 年起商用儀器問世，1970 年代引入石英單色器與半球分析器，1990 年代後影像 XPS、電荷中和與氣體團簇離子源成為標準配備。NIST 的 XPS 與非彈性平均自由徑資料庫以及 ISO 15472 校正標準，使不同儀器的結合能與定量可以互相比較。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯。~In the 1950s and 1960s Kai Siegbahn at Uppsala University built high-resolution electron spectrometers, demonstrated chemical shifts of core-level binding energies and named the technique ESCA, earning the 1981 Nobel Prize in Physics; commercial instruments appeared from 1969, quartz monochromators and hemispherical analysers arrived in the 1970s, and imaging XPS, charge neutralisation and gas-cluster ion sources became standard after the 1990s. The NIST XPS and inelastic-mean-free-path databases and the ISO 15472 calibration standard make binding energies and quantification comparable between instruments. This course reconstructs only public principles and engineering logic.
